headline: Nigerian Stocks Drop N3 Trillion as Dangote Cement and Banks Suffer Heavy Sell-Off
summary: A three-day sell-off erased N3 trillion from the Nigerian stock market capitalisation following profit-taking in Dangote Cement, Aradel, and major commercial banks. The decline was exacerbated by falling international oil prices and naira weakness.
why: The Nigerian Exchange (NGX) reflects domestic corporate earnings, financial sector liquidity, and macroeconomic foreign exchange dynamics in West Africa.

impacts.name: NGX All-Share Index
impacts.why: Heavy profit-taking in industrial weights and commercial banks dragged Nigerian equity market capitalisation down.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Macroeconomic liquidity shifts, local currency weakness, and falling crude oil prices drove heavy profit-taking across Nigerian equities.
